## Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles (`npm run typecheck`) and passes lint (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] New / changed code has tests (`npm test`)
- [ ] Updated user-facing docs / README / OpenAPI as needed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or `.env` values added to source
- [ ] Verified the change locally (POS, admin, mobile or desktop where relevant)
